notes: 'even' before David is added: no marker or connective stands on the appositive (rule 16).
Both waws rendered 'with' (אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ, דָּוִד וּשְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו) take that word under rule 14.
אֵשֶׁת־נָבָל → 'Nabal's wife' as a possessive recasting (rule 29); הַכַּרְמְלִית aligned to 'the Carmelitess' across the ASV's reordering.
